# MGP Coatings

Concrete coating and epoxy flooring contractor serving San Luis Obispo County, California. Polyurea and polyaspartic garage floor systems, pool decks, patios, driveways, and epoxy countertops.

## What makes the system different
MGP installs polyurea and polyaspartic coating systems rather than DIY-style epoxy kits. These cure faster than traditional epoxy, which is what allows a one-day installation on most residential garages, and they are more resistant to UV yellowing and hot-tire pickup.
